findings.title: Foundry client placeholder lacks an implementation path
findings.evidence: Current SDK documents Entra-authenticated project client and Responses operations.
findings.recommendation: Add concrete single-turn client with dependency, identity, validation and execution limits.
findings.resolution: Add concrete single-turn client with dependency, identity, validation and execution limits.

findings.title: Agent invocation and resource creation are different operations
findings.evidence: Named-agent-bound client invokes an existing portal resource.
findings.recommendation: Add agent client and conversation/version/retention distinctions.
findings.resolution: Add agent client and conversation/version/retention distinctions.

findings.title: Batch request success can hide failed documents
findings.evidence: Python API returns per-document is_error results.
findings.recommendation: Preserve errors in a small client example and coverage calculations.
findings.resolution: Preserve errors in a small client example and coverage calculations.

findings.title: One-shot speech recognition is bounded
findings.evidence: Up to 30 seconds or silence with no-match and canceled outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Add result handling, longer-audio boundary and original speech metrics.
findings.resolution: Add result handling, longer-audio boundary and original speech metrics.

findings.title: Related GA announcements do not establish voice prompt-agent GA
findings.evidence: Feature quickstart explicitly preview with project/region and SDK prerequisites.
findings.recommendation: Keep separate feature scope and direct multimodal versus Speech pipeline.
findings.resolution: Keep separate feature scope and direct multimodal versus Speech pipeline.

findings.title: Specific Image Analysis API has a retirement date
findings.recommendation: Add scoped lifecycle and scenario-based alternatives without all-vision retirement claim.
findings.resolution: Add scoped lifecycle and scenario-based alternatives without all-vision retirement claim.

findings.title: Not every analyzer has the same operation and model requirements
findings.evidence: Preview synchronous Read/Layout; Read/Layout no-model exception; other workflows retain contracts.
findings.recommendation: Add GA/preview choice table and operation/model dependency boundary.
findings.resolution: Add GA/preview choice table and operation/model dependency boundary.

findings.title: Prebuilt model aliases need actual deployment mappings
findings.evidence: Resource defaults or per-request modelDeployments with override precedence.
findings.recommendation: Add aliases, supportedModels and billing boundary.
findings.resolution: Add aliases, supportedModels and billing boundary.

findings.title: Structured fields and confidence are not verified business outcomes
findings.evidence: Opt-in field evidence; normalization; signature region detection.
findings.recommendation: Add evidence settings, local invoice validator and conservative interpretation.
findings.resolution: Add evidence settings, local invoice validator and conservative interpretation.

findings.title: Earlier duration total not reproduced
findings.evidence: Current concept and implementation outlines each expose seven modules but no aggregate runtime.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit editorial time budgets and current module counts.
findings.resolution: Use explicit editorial time budgets and current module counts.

findings.title: Empty training widgets do not mean no course exists
findings.evidence: Direct course and two paths are available despite credential widgets.
findings.recommendation: Direct learners to verified resources and separate unverified exam timing.
findings.resolution: Direct learners to verified resources and separate unverified exam timing.

findings.title: Feature announcements can become practical beginner exercises
findings.evidence: GA/preview extraction and evidence choices map to safe experiments.
findings.recommendation: Add original selection worksheet without adopting marketing benchmark guarantees.
findings.resolution: Add original selection worksheet without adopting marketing benchmark guarantees.
